{{Quote|Not far from here, there's a bunker in the hands of Gamorrean raiders. Brutish deadly creatures, responsible for the massacre at the Vactooine mining colony.|[[Zola Arvannus]]|<ref name="TOR:DC" />}}
The '''Gamorrean Bunker''' was an abandoned [[Czerka Arms|Czerka]] facility<ref name="TOR:RtD" /> located among the [[Breezefield Farms]], in the [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], that had been taken over by a group of [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorreans]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="TOR:DC" /> It was later taken by an individual working on behalf of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] representative at Outpost Rennar, [[Zola Arvannus]], eliminating the Gamorreans in order to seize the complex for the Empire. This was done to avoid relying on the hospitality of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] living in the nearby [[Outpost Rennar]], who were letting the Empire use the outpost as a base.
